name: diagonal-marquee
title: Diagonal Marquee Carousel
description: Rows of image cards scrolling endlessly, the whole stack tilted diagonally, rows alternate direction, top/bottom fade. Great as a hero or section background.
darkMode: fade uses white / dark:neutral-950; override with fadeClassName (e.g. from-black)
mainProps: cards: {url, title, id?}[], angle, baseSpeed (seconds per loop), rows, alternateDirections, pauseOnHover, showFade, overlay, className, cardClassName, fadeClassName
notes: Default height is h-screen; pass className to change. Respects prefers-reduced-motion. Cards are 270x200 on mobile, 400x300 from md.
source: https://great-ui.com (Great UI by Saurabh Sharma, via 21st.dev)
